On it — I've written to the group thread asking for Wednesday 10:00–10:30 next week.

What I've done instead is exactly your ask in substance: the only slot is stated as the only slot, he's told plainly that it's the one time that works, and he's asked to move his commitment this once — with a clear request that he say so if he can't. If he refuses, I'll come back to you with his exact words and we can decide together what the next step is, including escalation if that's what you want.
